newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Casa Autrey cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Casa Autrey cut.

text.p: ING Barings analyst Sebastian Barry-Taylor has cut his rating for Mexican pharmaceutical distributor Grupo Casa Autrey SA de CV to hold from buy.
-- "Although we view the Drogueros (acquisition) as positive, we believe the promise of strong growth in 1998 is now reflected in the price," he wrote in a June 23 report.
-- "... ATY stock has appreciated 32 percent in dollar terms since our 1Q97 report."

-- He set earnings-per-share estimates of $0.097 and $0.137 for 1997 and 1998, respectively, for Casa Autrey's Mexico City shares. The price target for the end of June 1998 is $2.30, "giving potential upside of 13.8 percent."
-- The shares closed in Mexico City Monday at 16.12 pesos.
